law_name: Law No. 1.565 of 3 December 2024 on the Protection of Personal Data
applies_to: Controllers and processors established in Monaco and those abroad processing data of persons in Monaco
key_requirements: GDPR-style accountability (controller at the heart of compliance); security measures (art. 31); breach notification (art. 32 ff.); eight data-subject rights
enforcement_authority: Autorite de Protection des Donnees Personnelles (APDP)
penalties_range: Administrative fines of up to EUR 10 million (government announcement)
notes: Replaces Law 1.165 of 1993 and the CCIN; implemented by Sovereign Ordinance 11.327 of 2025-07-10. Compliance deadline for existing processing reportedly 2025-12-14. Effective date from a single secondary source; one commentary suggests sanctions applied from mid-2025. Monaco ratified Convention 108+ on 2025-03-06.
